line: "You weren't supposed to find out like this."
"Tell me the truth—for once."
"If we do this, there's no going back."
"I thought you were on my side."
You knew this would happen, didn't you?
"I'm not the person you think I am."
"Say that again and mean it this time."
"We're running out of time."
"This wasn't part of the plan."
"You owe me the truth."
"This changes everything."
"You should have trusted me."
"I didn't have a choice."
"We're not safe here."
"Don't make me do this."
"You don't understand what's at stake."
"I've been waiting for this moment."
"You don't get to walk away from this."
"I trusted you."
"This is bigger than both of us."
"You're hiding something."
"I won't let you do this alone."
"We're out of options."
"Tell me what really happened."
"You should have told me sooner."
"This isn't just about us anymore."
"I thought we were in this together."
"You don't know what I've been through."
"We can't keep running forever."
"I never wanted it to come to this."
"You don't get to decide what's best for me."
"This is our last chance."
"I thought I could trust you."
"You don't understand how much this means to me."
"We have to face this together."
"I can't believe you kept this from me."
"This is the moment we've been preparing for."
You don't know what you're getting into.
"I thought we had more time."
"You should have been honest with me."
"This is bigger than anything we've faced before."
"I can't believe you lied to me."
"We have to stick together."
"You don't understand what I've been through to get here."
"This is our only chance."
"I thought we were on the same side."
"We have to face this head-on."
"I need facts, not promises."
"If you're asking for trust, start with honesty."
"Don't confuse silence with agreement."
"You can blame me later. Right now, move."
"I didn't come back for closure. I came back for answers."
"We're not done until everyone gets out."
"Say what you mean before it's too late."
"This isn't bravery. It's the only option left."
"If you keep looking at me like that, I'm going to forget my plan."
"You always stand too close when you're pretending not to care."
"Say my name again, but this time like you mean it."
"We're arguing because it's easier than admitting this matters."
"I can handle danger. I can't handle you walking away."
"Tell me to stay, and I will."
You touch my hand like it's an accident every time.
"Don't kiss me because it's easy. Kiss me because it's true."
"We're terrible at timing and worse at pretending."
"If this is a goodbye, then stop looking at me like a promise."
